# Webrivio

> Webrivio is a web design studio in Toronto, Ontario that builds custom websites for small
> businesses. Websites start at $499 CAD and go live in 48 hours once the client provides their
> content and payment. Clients own their code outright.

Webrivio was founded by Rudra Garg (Founder & Designer) and Ayzah Ashraf (Co-founder, Client
Relations & Outreach) after they won a competition and were accepted into Summer Company, a
Province of Ontario program that awarded them a $3,000 startup grant. They started the studio
because small businesses were routinely being overcharged by web designers and getting very
little in return. That is why the price is $499 and why it is published openly.

Key facts:
- Location: Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Service-area business serving Toronto and the GTA
  (North York, Scarborough, Etobicoke, Mississauga, Brampton, Markham, Vaughan, Richmond Hill).
- Price: from $499 CAD. The Flagship package (a five-page custom site) is $499. Smaller jobs on
  existing sites (Foundation) and larger builds (Flagship+) are quoted on scope, in writing,
  before work starts.
- Delivery: live in 48 hours, measured from when the client provides content and payment.
- Ownership: the client owns the code, the domain, and all accounts.
- Contact: hello@webrivio.com · (437) 494-1295
- Webrivio publishes no testimonials or reviews. The home page and case-studies page show client
  builds (new sites and rebuilds of an existing site) for businesses including a Toronto law firm,
  a Muskoka roofing company, a Waterloo Region cleaning company, a hypnotist, a training charity,
  a home services company, a hair salon and a food bank. Each card is labelled for what it is. No
  business is named without its owner's permission.

## Quick answers

- How much does a website cost with Webrivio? From $499 CAD, a fixed number agreed in writing on a
  free 15-20 minute call, before any work starts.
- How fast is it live? 48 hours from the moment the client's content and payment are both in.
- Who owns the website? The client: the code, the domain and every account.
- What happens after an inquiry? A reply within one business day, then a free 15-20 minute fit
  call where the price is put in writing.
- Does Webrivio rebuild existing websites? Yes. The case-studies page shows before-and-after
  rebuilds next to new builds.
- Where does Webrivio work? Toronto and the GTA, by call and email. There is no walk-in office.

- [What a Website Costs in Toronto](https://webrivio.com/website-cost-toronto): An honest guide to Toronto web design pricing across DIY builders, freelancers, and agencies, and where Webrivio sits.
- [Roofing Website Design in Toronto](https://webrivio.com/roofing-website-design-toronto): Websites built for Toronto roofing contractors, including a concept build.

- [About](https://webrivio.com/about): Rudra Garg and Ayzah Ashraf, the Summer Company grant, and why the studio exists.
- [Contact](https://webrivio.com/contact): Project inquiry form and frequently asked questions.
